outside.input: {"command":"node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");fs.cpSync(\"/tmp/spec-backup/specs\",\"tests/specs\",{recursive:true});' && grep -rnE \"zz\\`|quantity \\+ 1\\)|PURCHASE_LIMIT \\+ 1|delivery, 0\\)|totals\\.items\\)|basket\\(0\\)\" tests/specs; git status --short && npx playwright test 2>&1 | tail -12","description":"Restore specs, verify no mutation remains, rerun all","timeout":600000}
